judged_text: In poll_feed, i.content is nil for RSS items lacking content:encoded (simple-rss exposes Atom <content>, not RSS <description>), so nil.scrub raises NoMethodError — and with sidekiq_options retry: false (app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:12) the hourly poll dies silently forever.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the code does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`. If `SimpleRSS` returns an item where `i.content` is `nil` (e.g., feeds that don’t provide a `content` field), `nil.scrub` will raise `NoMethodError`, crashing the poll run. The diff shows no nil-guard or fallback (like `description`). While the claim that it “dies silently forever” isn’t directly verifiable from the diff, the unhandled nil dereference is a concrete defect.
